desc: Are you concerned about using pepper spray in a windy location or closed environment with innocent bystanders, like a shopping mall? The Tactical Series of SABRE Red pepper gel is the answer for these conditions. SABRE pepper spray gel goes directly to its target, with no blowback and a greater range than other pepper sprays. With the same powerful stopping formula as our other products, SABRE pepper gel spray gives you the edge in difficult situations, so that you can quickly and safely reach your intended target without harming others.
